notes: «إنا لعند ابن عباس» names a place, so Ibn Abbas is not a link (rule 6); «قال حدثني أبى بن كعب» has no named speaker, so the one who relays from Ubayy is implicit: needs ruling (rule 11)
«وغيرهما قد سمعته يحدثه» is a remark on other hearers with no named link; «قرأها ابن عباس» is a reading remark, left out
